prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the report; the Telegraph article could not be fetched. Microsoft has cancelled its deal to be the anchor tenant of Nscale's planned data center in Essex, UK, where it was to rent 23,000 Nvidia AI chips.
The site had faced repeated delays, and Microsoft's exit threatens Nscale's planned multibillion-dollar listing.
highlights: Microsoft pulls out as anchor tenant of Nscale's Essex data center
Basis: Techmeme summary; Telegraph original not retrievable
